doc: The optional HTTP transfer profile (LCP-041): requests that report upload and download progress, and uploads of files the user picked with the files pack, by opaque id — alone or as multipart form data. No File, Blob or FormData crosses. Outcomes keep Core Http's four-way semantics: a timeout after the request was sent is OutcomeUnknown, never a failure. Retry, caching and authentication stay in the engine. An application that does not register this pack pays nothing for it.

constants.name: MAX_TRANSFER_RESPONSE_BYTES
constants.doc: The largest text or base64 response body, as in Core Http.

types.name: TransferCredentials
types.doc: omit is refused as InvalidRequest: the transfer transport (XMLHttpRequest) always sends same-origin cookies. Core Http honours omit.

types.name: Part
types.doc: One field of a multipart/form-data body.

variants.name: file
variants.doc: A file the files pack issued; fileName defaults to the picked file's own name.

variants.name: file
variants.doc: The raw bytes of a picked file; the content type is the file's own unless given.

variants.name: send
variants.doc: Send one request. With progress, Progress facts follow for this request (by its correlation id), at most one per progressIntervalMs per direction, and always the final one; without, the pack registers no progress listener at all.

types.name: TransferFailureReason
types.doc: network: no response arrived. invalid-response: a response arrived but its body did not decode as asked. too-large: the body passed MAX_TRANSFER_RESPONSE_BYTES. unknown-file: a file id the files pack does not know (released, or never issued). no-files: a file body without a files pack wired to this one.

variants.name: Cancelled
variants.doc: The engine cancelled it. If the request was already sent, the server may still have acted on it; the engine that must know asks the server.

variants.name: OutcomeUnknown
variants.doc: The timeout passed after the request was sent: it may have been applied.

fields.name: request
fields.doc: The correlation id of the send request.

fields.name: total
fields.doc: Absent when the size is not known.
